αἴαντ: Αἴας — Ajax; masc. voc. dual, elided (Αἴαντ’ = Αἴαντε): ’you two Ajaxes’

αἴας: Αἴας — Ajax, Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.

βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.

γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γυναῖκα: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg.

ζωστῆρα: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. acc. sg.
ζωόν: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. sg., epic ζωός (= Attic ζῶν)

μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’

μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic (= Attic μου); κλῦθί μευ ’hear me’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)

νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
νεκροὺς: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. pl.: ’the dead’
νεώμεθα: νέομαι — go, go back, return; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’

νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
ξίφος: ξίφος — sword; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., as subject (ξίφος ἄγη ’the sword was broken’)

οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction

οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’

πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.

περικλυτὰ: περικλυτός — very famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
περιφραδέως: περιφραδέως — very thoughtfully, carefully (adv. of περιφραδής)

πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προκαλέσσατο: προκαλέω — call forth, challenge; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic προὐκαλέσατο): ’challenged’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προσιόντα: πρόσειμι (εἶμι) — go to, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’approaching’
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
προφυγόντα: προφεύγω — flee forth from, escape; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg., + acc.: ’having escaped’
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen.
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; fem. acc. sg.
πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also masc. acc. sg., of a plot: ’close-woven, cunning’ (πυκινὸν δόλον ’a cunning trap’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόλεμος: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg.
πόνου: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. gen. sg., after παύσαντο: ’from toil’
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking, drink; fem. gen. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’husband’), after ἔρον: ’desire for drink’
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
σήμερον: σήμερον — today, this day; adv. (Attic τήμερον)
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι: τίς δὲ σύ ἐσσι ’who are you?’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέθει: τελέθω — be, prove to be; pres. 3 sg., poetic: ’is, has come to be’
τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
τετύκοντό: τεύχω — make, prepare; epic reduplicated aor. 3 pl. mid. (accented before enclitic τε): ’they prepared’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῳάδας: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. acc. pl., object of αἰδέομαι: ’Trojan women’
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a pronoun object: ’small, little’ (τυτθὸν ἐόντα ’being small’)
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; masc. acc. sg.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
φέρτατός: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl. of φέρτερος, masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’
φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
φαεινόν: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζωστῆρα
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
φοίνικι: φοῖνιξ — crimson, purple-red (the dye); masc. dat. sg., instrumental
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing; with the opt., potential: ’would’ · also with the subj. after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ χ’ … πύθηαι ’if you ever hear’)
χάρησαν: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 pl. (pass. form, active sense), unaugmented (= ἐχάρησαν): ’were glad’
χάρμῃ: χάρμη — joy of battle, battle; fem. dat. sg., with προκαλέσσατο: ’in the joy of battle’
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
ἀάπτους: ἄαπτος — meaning unknown (traditionally ’untouchable’ or ’irresistible’); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
ἀγαθὸν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(not) good’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a named man: ’good’ (πὺξ ἀγαθὸν Πολυδεύκεα ’Polydeuces, good with his fists’)
ἀγαμέμνονα: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. acc. sg.
ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγερώχων: ἀγέρωχος — lofty, proud (meaning uncertain); adj., masc. gen. pl.
ἀγορήσατο: ἀγοράομαι — speak in the assembly; aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἀγορεύειν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); pres. inf.
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀγορὴ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
ἀγρόμενοι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; syncopated aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ἀθροισθέντες): ’having gathered’
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλεξάνδροιο: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀμείνονα: ἀμείνων — better; comparative of ἀγαθός; masc. acc. sg.
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’answering’
ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., with τε following it
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
ἀντήνωρ: Ἀντήνωρ — Antenor, one of the Trojan elders; masc. nom. sg.
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς) · also of fighting, ’head-on, face to face’ (ἀντικρὺ μάχεσθαι ’to fight head-on’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀποδώσω: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, hand over; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will give back’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the best’
ἀραρυίας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic reduplicated -υῖα, no Attic prose equivalent: ’fitted’
ἀργείην: Ἀργεῖος — Argive, of Argos; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -είην (= Attic Ἀργείαν)
ἀριστῆες: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἀρτεμέα: ἀρτεμής — safe, sound, unharmed; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀρτεμῆ)
ἀτάλαντος: ἀτάλαντος — equal (in weight), a match for; adj., masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’equal to’
ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου) · also son of Atreus, i.e. Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀτρεΐδῃς: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. dat. pl., epic Ἀτρεΐδῃς (= Attic Ἀτρείδαις): ’the sons of Atreus’
ἀτρεΐδῃσιν: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (Agamemnon, Menelaus); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’)
ἄγ: ἄγε (elided ἄγ’) — come!, come now; interjection, originally 2 sg. imper. of ἄγω ’lead’, used before another imperative
ἄγειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. inf. act.
ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group · also ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετο): ’brought for himself’ (of taking a bride)
ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἦγον): ’were leading’
ἄκρῃ: ἄκρος — topmost, high; adj., fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ) · also ἄκρη — headland, height; fem. dat. sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄμμε: ἐγώ — I; acc. pl. ’us’, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄργεος: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐΐσης: ἐΐσος — equal, fair-shared (epic, = Attic ἴσος); fem. gen. sg., agreeing with δαιτός
ἐγγύθι: ἐγγύθι — near, close by; adv., + gen.: ’near Priam’s’
ἐδεύετο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was lacking’
ἐδητύος: ἐδητύς — eating, food; fem. gen. sg., after ἔρον: ’desire for food’
ἐθέλω: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 1 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα): ’being’
ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπιβρίσῃ: ἐπιβρίθω — press upon, weigh down, come down heavily; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after ὅτε in a general clause
ἐπιθεῖναι: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, lay over; aor. inf. act.: ’to shut (by laying over)’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐρύσαντό: ἐρύω — draw, drag; pull off a spit; aor. 3 pl. mid., accented before enclitic τε
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
ἑλκεσιπέπλους: ἑλκεσίπεπλος — with trailing robes; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with Τρῳάδας
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔλπομαι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid./dep., + inf.: ’I expect’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); masc. acc. sg., object of ἕντο with ἐξ: ’put away desire’
ἔτας: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman; masc. acc. pl. (nom. pl. ἔται)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλεσθε: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’take to yourselves’
ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ (ἐξ … ἕντο): ’they put away (desire)’
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠϋκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος (= ἐΰκομος) — fair-haired; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Βρισηΐδος · also agreeing with Ἑλένης: ’fair-haired (Helen)’ · also agreeing with Θέτιδος: ’fair-haired (Thetis)’ · also agreeing with Ἀθηναίης: ’fair-haired (Athena)’
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἤϊ: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ἤϊε, elided (ἤϊ’ = ἤϊε; Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
ἦγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl.: ’were leading’
ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’ · also elided ἦρχον, impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀσκάλαφος καὶ Ἰάλμενος) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., + gen.: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς)
ἰδαῖος: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. nom. sg. · also Idaeus, a Trojan, son of Dares; masc. nom. sg.
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἱέρευσεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable
ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go, let him come’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj.
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπερμενέϊ: ὑπερμενής — overmastering, very mighty; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
ὑψηλοὺς: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. acc. pl., with Ἐρυθίνους
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
